method: HuggingFace public dataset snapshots; prompt-pair-group-disjoint train/calibration/test

sources.notes: Human answers and ChatGPT answers share a question; split by question ID. Source copyright and CC BY-SA obligations require review.
Chosen/rejected are preference-training labels, not independently audited human/AI authorship. Short Arabic responses may not meet 75-word requirement. Never use as production test data.

output_safety: Private training corpus; do not commit source content, model weights or licenses incorrectly.
